description: An Android sample application demonstrating bitmap alpha transparency, including custom drawing and shader use.

classes.name: AlphaBitmap
classes.description: Main activity extending GraphicsActivity, setting up a custom view for bitmap alpha demonstration.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View class that handles drawing bitmaps with alpha transparency and shader effects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to a SampleView instance.

methods.name: drawIntoBitmap
methods.description: Draws a circle and text into a bitmap with specified alpha and PorterDuff transfer mode.

methods.name: SampleView (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the view, loads bitmap resources, extracts alpha channel, creates a new bitmap, and sets up gradient shader.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the view's draw method to render bitmaps and shader effects onto the canvas.
